target: both qubits initially classified G, both have >=3 consecutive non-G samples among the next 33 readouts
scheduling_policy: choose one contiguous 100 ms interval of the periodic mechanical phase minimizing training product-marginal error prediction; predict observed persistent double excursion in validation
validation_label: retrospective ordered acquisition split; no IID-shot confidence claim
uncertainty: report every contiguous 50-acquisition validation block and deterministic range; model/future generalization not established
physical_model: conditional independence of the two entire local readout-state processes given mechanical phase; stationary phase response from training to validation; single-qubit memory otherwise unrestricted
policy_weighting: Training both-ground initial-state exposure; joint excursion outcomes are not used.
record: Recorded locally before computing this target; not externally preregistered. Source plots and related outcomes were already inspected.
secondary_after_validation: fixed-policy phase shifts -20 to +20 primary bins
scope: Observed readout classifications and retrospective phase selection, not intrinsic transitions, online scheduling, copper causality, or a QEC resource.
